items.title: India Looks to China for a Way Around Pakistan’s Airspace Closure
items.summary: India is looking east to solve a problem that has been forcing its airlines to fly west the long way around.

items.title: Kayak Co-Founders Launch Lola — Booking Holdings’ New AI Assistant: Exclusive
items.summary: Booking Holdings has spent years trying to stitch a trip together across separate apps. Lola wagers one assistant built from scratch, with a membership model and human concierge service, can finally hold it together.

items.title: Alaska Airlines Adds Premium Economy and More Business Class — Can It Catch Up to the Big 3?
items.summary: Despite grappling with a surge in high fuel costs, Alaska Airlines is doubling down on premium travel with more business class seats across its fleet and the introduction of premium economy.

items.title: EU Anti-Greenwashing Rules Take Effect— and Some Eco-Labels May Not Survive
items.summary: Hotel and airline sustainability chiefs welcome the enforcement of legislation that they expect will cut the number of eco-labels — the question is, which ones will survive?

items.title: Europe Is Where Travel AI Has to Prove It Can Work Across Borders
items.summary: Travel AI has to work across languages, brands, booking systems and regulatory boundaries. Europe brings those challenges together—and gives the companies solving them a chance to shape how travel gets sold.

items.title: Air India Has Bulked Up. Incoming CEO Tells Staff to Focus on Safety, Reliability — and Profit
items.summary: Tewolde Gebremariam has plenty to fix at Air India. His first townhall shows he understands the brief.

items.title: Hilton’s Motto Debut in Japan Signals a Bigger Mid-Market Shift
items.summary: If Japan reaches 60 million visitors by 2030 as planned, hotel companies will need more rooms, and more affordable ones. And that is exactly what Hilton aims to do.

items.title: Instinct’s App Is Fueled by Travel — Founder Says It’s Half of Volume
items.summary: Instinct got travel's attention by handling bookings via text message. Now the real question is whether it can turn that volume into revenue — and travel may be the test case.
